# BARBER — Men's Barbershop in Madinaty (حلاق رجالي في مدينتي)

> BARBER is a men's barbershop with 5 branches inside Madinaty, New Cairo, Egypt. Haircuts, fades, beard styling, hair and beard color, protein treatment and facials. Instagram: @barber._.eg
